# Time-Series Analysis of Sea Turtle Nesting

::: {.cgm-page-lead}
Examine interannual variability and longer-term trends in nesting activity.
:::

[← Sea Turtle Nesting & Species Distribution Modeling](turtles.qmd)

:::

::: {.cgm-page-body}

These patterns are explored through time-series analyses to assess interannual variability and longer-term trends in nesting activity.

This project is part of the lab’s sea turtle nesting research using long-term nesting activity data from Escambia County, Florida.

:::
